build_roberta_model: build a RoBERTa model instance using RobertaModel.build_model with args and task
register_classification_head: register a classification head on a RoBERTa model with num_classes and inner_dim
extract_features: extract features from input tokens using RobertaEncoder.extract_features method
load_pretrained_roberta: load a pretrained RoBERTa model using RobertaModel.from_pretrained with model name
get_normalized_probs: get normalized probabilities or log probs from RoBERTa model output logits
